subject: Table 10.3: Aggregating over rows/columns in Occupancy GoF

messages.author: 3fac8f4565858af2
messages.subject: Table 10.3: Aggregating over rows/columns in Occupancy GoF
parts:
Hi all,
I am trying to replicate Table 10.3 in Section 10.8, Goodness-of-fit, since the code is not included in the online companion (any suggested code is welcome).  I want to make sure that I understand exactly how Kery and Royle aggregated over columns and rows: a simple sum across rows or columns for the observed and expected values? 

My results are slightly different but that could just be due to random error. As an example, here are my results and some code showing how I calculated the first row of Table 10.3:
#                        Chi2 on Cells         Chi2 on Rows         Chi2 on Columns     MB Test
# This sim:   0.68 (0.03-0.95) 0.11 (0.00-0.47) 0.00 (0.00-0.88) 0.00 (0.00-0.01)
# Table 10.3:   0.78 (0.30-0.98) 0.18 (0.02-0.81) 0.00 (0.00-0.03) 0.00 (0.00-0.01)

############################### Strong behavioral response (b=2)
########## Chisq Test on Cells and Aggregated data for Strong behavioral response (b=2)
library(AHMbook)
library(unmarked)
library(AICcmodavg)

set.seed(1)

fitstats <- function(fm) {
  observed <- getY(fm@data) #on cells
  expected <- fitted(fm)    #on cells
  hSit <- rowSums(observed) #on rows; aggregate over columns
  fSit <- rowSums(expected) #on rows; aggregate over columns
  hTmp <- colSums(observed) #on columns; aggregate over rows
  fTmp <- colSums(expected) #on columns; aggregate over rows
  chisq <- sum((observed - expected)^2 / expected, na.rm=T) #on cells
  chisqSit <- sum((hSit - fSit)^2 / fSit, na.rm=T) #on rows; aggregate over columns
  chisqTmp <- sum((hTmp - fTmp)^2 / fTmp, na.rm=T) #on columns; aggregate over rows
  out <- c(Chisq=chisq, ChisqSit=chisqSit, ChisqTmp=chisqTmp)
  return(out)
}

stime=Sys.time()

nd=20
pb.fm <- matrix(nrow=nd,ncol=3)
for (d in 1:nd) {
  
  data <- simOcc(M = 267, J = 3, mean.occupancy = 0.6, beta1 = 0, beta2 = 1, beta3 = 0, mean.detection = 0.3, time.effects = c(0, 0), alpha1 = 1, alpha2 = -1, alpha3 = 0, sd.lp = 0, b = 2, show.plot=F)
  umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(
    y = data$y,
    siteCovs = data.frame(forest = data$forest),
    obsCovs = list(elev = matrix(rep(data$elev, data$J), ncol = data$J), wind = data$wind))
  
  fm <- occu(~elev+wind ~forest, data=umf)
  
  pb <- parboot(fm, fitstats, nsim=500, report=500)
  
  pb.fm[d,1] <- sum((abs(p...@t.star[,"Chisq"] - 1) > abs(pb@t0["Chisq"] - 1))/ (1 + 500)) #Pr(t_B > t0)
  pb.fm[d,2] <- sum((abs(p...@t.star[,"ChisqSit"] - 1) > abs(pb@t0["ChisqSit"] - 1))/ (1 + 500)) #Pr(t_B > t0)
  pb.fm[d,3] <- sum((abs(p...@t.star[,"ChisqTmp"] - 1) > abs(pb@t0["ChisqTmp"] - 1))/ (1 + 500)) #Pr(t_B > t0)
  
}

(evalTime = difftime(Sys.time(),stime)) #Time difference ~10s/dataset * 20 = 3 min.

########## MB Test on Det. History Cohorts for Strong behavioral response (b=2)
stime=Sys.time()

set.seed(1)

nd=20
mb.gof.test.fm <- NULL
for (d in 1:nd) {
  
  data <- simOcc(M = 267, J = 3, mean.occupancy = 0.6, beta1 = 0, beta2 = 1, beta3 = 0, mean.detection = 0.3, time.effects = c(0, 0), alpha1 = 1, alpha2 = -1, alpha3 = 0, sd.lp = 0, b = 2, show.plot=F)
  umf <- unmarkedFrameOccu(
    y = data$y,
    siteCovs = data.frame(forest = data$forest),
    obsCovs = list(elev = matrix(rep(data$elev, data$J), ncol = data$J), wind = data$wind))
  
  fm <- occu(~elev+wind ~forest, data=umf)
  mb.gof.test.fm[d] <- mb.gof.test(fm, nsim = 100, plot.hist = F, report = NULL, parallel = TRUE)$p.value
  
} #d

(evalTime = difftime(Sys.time(),stime)) #Time difference ~45s/dataset * 20 = 15 min.

########## output to compare to AHM
Table10.3 <- matrix(nrow=2,ncol=4)
Table10.3[1,1] <- "Chi2 on Cells"
Table10.3[2,1] <- paste0(
  round(median(pb.fm[,1]),2),
  " (",
     round(min(pb.fm[,1]),2),
  "-",
     round(max(pb.fm[,1]),2),
  ")")

  "-",

Table10.3[1,3] <- "Chi2 on Columns"

  " (",
     round(min(pb.fm[,3]),2),
  "-",
     round(max(pb.fm[,3]),2),
  ")")

Table10.3[1,4] <- "MB Test"
Table10.3[2,4] <- paste0(
  round(median(mb.gof.test.fm),2),
  " (",
     round(min(mb.gof.test.fm),2),
  "-",
     round(max(mb.gof.test.fm),2),
  ")")
